integrity: Unrestricted graph-family statement proved by explicit finite block analysis, an even-bridge parity argument, and product shattering constructions. Supporting finite enumerator is included. This is not an independent review.
limitations: The graphs have cut edges; no two-connected statement or arbitrary-ladder-width formula is claimed. Mathematical priority under alternative dimer/online-learning terminology remains incompletely checked.
title: A linear static–adaptive shattering gap for perfect matchings in connected subcubic planar graphs
